SR-G3.ko: 눈물 성배에 물이 차올라 밀물처럼 흘러넘침
SR-G3.equip: a pearl chalice is raised with a delicate clink, clear water wells up and overflows in a gentle rolling tide, and a soft shimmering wash flows outward

G3-01.ko: 작은 물방울 쏘아 톡 · 떨리는 물막이 흔들림
G3-01.atk: a shy tremble of a glass-bowl hum, one small bead of water flicks off a fingertip with a tiny plip, then a faint wavering splash against the target
G3-01.def: a thin quivering water film wobbles around her: a soft wet slap, a fragile glassy shimmer that trembles and settles, a few small drips

G3-02.ko: 물방울이 튀어 톡 · 터져 흩어졌다 다시 모임
G3-02.atk: a tiny droplet springs up with a bright plink, arcs through the air with a quick whistle, and bursts into a crisp little spatter on impact
G3-02.def: it has no armour: the soft bubbly body pops with a wet pop, a few droplets scatter and pitter, then re-gather with a faint gurgle

G3-03.ko: 꼬리 물장구 찰박 · 몸 굴려 피함
G3-03.atk: a quick flick of a small tail fin, a light slapping splash of kicked water, then a bright little smack as the shiny pebble in his mouth clicks against the foe
G3-03.def: he darts sideways instead of blocking: a squeaky wet flip, a fast ripple, scales brushing a rock with a glancing scrape and a soft flinch of bubbles

G3-04.ko: 껍데기를 탁 닫아 물어뜯음 · 껍데기를 닫고 버팀
G3-04.atk: a heavy ridged shell creaks open with a soft gurgle, then snaps shut on the target with a hard hollow clack and a puff of bubbles
G3-04.def: it clamps its shell closed: a sharp shell-on-steel knock, a grinding hinge creak, sand hissing around its base as it holds fast

G3-06.ko: 물결 타고 주둥이로 들이받음 · 몸판으로 받고 출렁
G3-06.atk: a quick flutter of fins, a rushing swirl of water as it rides a ripple, then a sharp snout butt with a hollow knock and a burst of bubbles
G3-06.def: its ridged plates take the blow: a light hollow clack, a bubbly click, the curled tail unwinding as it bobs back

G3-07.ko: 등 대고 떠 있다 작살을 던짐 · 물에 뛰어들어 비껴 맞음
G3-07.atk: a cheeky chirp, a quick splash as it rolls over, a small harpoon whooshes through the air and thunks home with a coral-tipped crack
G3-07.def: it ducks under with a splash: a glancing thump on dense wet fur, an indignant squeak, water dripping as it pops back up

G3-08.ko: 겹친 노래 메아리가 물결로 퍼져 침 · 메아리가 흩어졌다 다시 울림
G3-08.atk: layered voices ring out and repeat, each echo a little fainter, then expanding rings of water hum outward and strike with a bright chiming slap
G3-08.def: the blow breaks the echo apart: a scattering glassy shimmer of sound, a soft rush of water, then the voices drift back together in a fading hum

G3-09.ko: 똬리 풀며 차가운 창으로 찌름 · 비늘 꼬리로 감아 막음
G3-09.atk: coils slither loose with a dry rasp, a short hiss, then a cold wet spear thrust with a sharp piercing crack
G3-09.def: it wraps its scaled tail across the blow: a hard rasping clank of scales, shell armour clinking, a coiling slide on wet stone

G3-10.ko: 물개처럼 뛰어올라 몸통박치기 · 가죽을 둘러쓰고 받음
G3-10.atk: a playful seal bark, flippers slapping on wet rock, then a slippery body slam with a wet thud and a spray of foam
G3-10.def: it pulls its sealskin tight: a soft rubbery thump, a startled yelp, the wet pelt rustling and a splash as it slides back

G3-11.ko: 먹물 뿜고 여덟 팔로 휘감아 조임 · 물컹한 몸으로 흘려 받음
G3-11.atk: a soft burbling gurgle, a jet of ink hissing through the water, then eight arms whip and wrap with wet suction pops and a squeezing squelch
G3-11.def: the soft body gives way around the blow: a gloopy squish, suckers peeling off with small pops, a cloud of ink blooming with a muffled whoosh

G3-12.ko: 산호 등딱지로 밀쳐 들이받음 · 산호 껍질로 단단히 받음
G3-12.atk: slow flippers swish through water, a heavy shell lunges forward with a deep rush, then a coral-crusted shove lands with a gritty hollow knock
G3-12.def: the coral shell takes the blow: a hard hollow clonk, brittle coral crunching, barnacles grinding and a slow calm breath

G3-14.ko: 밀물처럼 덮쳐 이빨로 물어뜯음 · 거친 상어 가죽으로 받음
G3-14.atk: a surging rush of water, a dorsal fin slicing the surface with a hiss, then jaws lined with teeth snap shut with a tearing crunch
G3-14.def: rough sharkskin takes the blow: a gritty rasping scrape, a thick thump, the water pulling back with a sucking rush like an ebbing tide

G3-15.ko: 물줄기 모양 바꿔 쏴 · 그릇 따라 출렁
G3-15.atk: a thin stream pours with a bubbling trickle, whips into a tight pressurised jet that whistles across the gap, then smacks into the foe with a bright sharp splash
G3-15.def: the stream sloshes into whatever vessel is nearby: a deep glugging pour, the hit sinks in with a heavy plop, water settling in a swelling slow ripple

G3-16.ko: 단단한 주둥이로 찌르듯 들이받음 · 몸판으로 막고 꼬리로 버팀
G3-16.atk: fins whir in a rapid flutter, then a long armoured snout drives forward with a hard piercing knock and a crackle of bubbles
G3-16.def: ridged body plates take the hit: a solid hollow clack, the curled tail creaking tight around coral, and no step back

G3-17.ko: 통통한 몸으로 밀며 따뜻한 물살 · 출렁하며 받아냄
G3-17.atk: a soft low moan, a gentle swell of warm water, then a plump body nudges forward with a soft heavy bump and a warm splash
G3-17.def: the rounded body sinks into the blow: a muffled rubbery thump, a slow bubbling breath, warm water swelling and lapping back

G3-18.ko: 물기둥을 세웠다 무너뜨려 쓸어 냄 · 산호 가지로 딱딱하게 받음
G3-18.atk: brittle coral branches click as they rise, a roaring column of water surges up, then collapses in a heavy crashing wash
G3-18.def: branching coral takes the blow: a hard hollow knock, a brittle crackle as tips snap off, sea foam hissing down

G3-19.ko: 석호 물결 한 방향으로 쏴 · 큰 파도로 막음
G3-19.atk: the entire lagoon leans with a vast hush of sliding water, a long sweeping tide wave builds in a smooth swell, then rolls over the foe with a rich washing crash
G3-19.def: a broad calm wave stands up around her: a resonant low hum of deep water, the strike thuds into it and ripples out in a glassy ring-out that fades slowly

G3-24.ko: 물 위를 달려 소용돌이로 끌어내림 · 미역 갈기 휘감겨 받음
G3-24.atk: a watery whinny, hooves splashing across the surface, then a swirling roar of current that drags the target down with a deep sucking gurgle
G3-24.def: its wet hide and kelp mane take the blow: a slick slapping thud, seaweed whipping round, water churning as it rears

G3-27.ko: 가시 꼬리로 찔러 올림 · 등딱지로 받고 가장자리 가시로 되찌름
G3-27.atk: legs scuttle over sand with dry clicks, then a long spike tail swings up with a whip and a sharp stabbing tick
G3-27.def: the domed carapace takes the blow: a deep hollow clack, sand scraping beneath, and the spines along its rim pricking back with a hard little crackle

G3-28.ko: 졸음 실린 물결이 덮쳐 짓누름 · 노래가 흔들리며 받아냄
G3-28.atk: a slow, soft humming melody swells, a heavy hush of rolling water builds, then a drowsy wave settles over the target with a deep soft crash
G3-28.def: the blow ripples through the misty veil: the humming wavers, a gentle hushing wash of water, and the melody slowly picks up again

G3-29.ko: 형체 바뀌는 물 덩어리 쿵 · 흐르듯 받아냄
G3-29.atk: formless water rears up, bubbling and shifting pitch from bright to deep, then crashes down as a heavy bulk of liquid with a thick slosh and a rolling surge
G3-29.def: its body ripples and reshapes: the hit sinks in with a gloopy thick plunge, the surface flows back with a rich glassy lap, a swelling gurgle of deep water

G3-32.ko: 깊은 해저 울림 그르릉 · 압력 같은 묵직한 막
G3-32.atk: a deep sub-bass pressure groan stirs in the dark, a thick current heaves, then a crushing hydraulic blast of dark water slams down with a booming shockwave and rolling foam
G3-32.def: his massive scaled tail swings round as a wall: a heavy wet whump against thick plates, a creaking of strained pressure, then a low rumbling ring-out in the deep

G3-33.ko: 깊은 곳에서 촉수가 솟아 휘감아 끌어내림 · 물컹한 몸으로 받고 먹물
G3-33.atk: a deep rumble rises like a heartbeat from below, the water bulges, then barbed tentacles erupt and wrap with heavy wet slaps and grinding suction
G3-33.def: the vast soft body absorbs the hit: a gloopy heavy thud, tentacles recoiling with slaps, a dark cloud of ink blooming with a low whoosh

G3-34.ko: 큰 집게로 내려쳐 집음 · 가시 등딱지로 받고 찔림
G3-34.atk: armoured legs clatter forward, a massive claw rises with a grinding creak, then crushes shut with a heavy cracking snap
G3-34.def: the spiny carapace takes the blow: a hard armoured clank, spines rasping back at the attacker, and a slow defiant click of claws

G3-36.ko: 밀물이 높이 솟아 덮쳐 내림 · 물결이 받고 다시 차오름
G3-36.atk: a deep rising surge rolls in, foam hissing along its crest, then a towering swell crashes down with a heavy watery boom
G3-36.def: the blow sinks into a wall of water: a thick sloshing plunge, the swell sinking back, then rising again with a steady roaring fill

G3-41.ko: 물살 타고 솟구쳐 들이받아 뚫음 · 몸으로 맞고 크게 튕김
G3-41.atk: high clicks and a whistle, a rushing surge of current, then a breaching charge that slams through with a heavy crunching splash
G3-41.def: no armour at all: a slapping thud on glossy skin, a startled whistle, and a heavy splash as it is knocked rolling

G3-42.ko: 해일을 타고 덮쳐 쓸어 버림 · 맞으면 물보라 속에서 몸부림
G3-42.atk: a roaring surf builds, a long hiss as coils ride the crest, then a towering wave crashes down with scattering shields and spray
G3-42.def: no guard, the serpent is struck mid-coil: a wet slapping thud, a pained hiss, coils thrashing in churning foam

SP-G3.ko: 몸이 물로 흘러 쏴 · 칼이 물을 가르고 상처가 아묾
SP-G3.atk: her body flows into one rushing river that swells with a smooth surge, rises into a towering glassy crest with a deep resonant hum, then crashes in a pearly cascade
SP-G3.def: a blade passes through her watery form with a soft cleaving swish and nothing but a ripple, then a warm bubbling trickle as the water closes and heals over

UN-G3.atk: a spring wells with a hollow resonating bubble, a gentle swell pushes outward, then breaks as a wave that washes away and returns again with a second softer lapping slap
UN-G3.def: the water gives way and flows back: the blow plunges into her with a deep muffled glug, a returning ripple rolls up the pool with a soft echoing lap

UN-G3-7.ko: 소라 울림 공명 · 조개 같은 공명막
UN-G3-7.atk: an eerie low conch-like resonance swells out of deep water and rings in the air, then a sudden hard crack of a snapped steel blade as it is turned back, with chilling bubbles
UN-G3-7.def: a ringing shell-like hum surrounds her, the strike dies against it in a hollow glassy knock, and the lingering resonance wavers with a slow ghostly shimmer

EP-G3-1.ko: 빛나는 촉수가 찌릿 쏨 · 물결을 세워 칼끝을 흘림
EP-G3-1.atk: a soft pulsing whoosh as the glowing bell contracts, trailing tentacles brush out with tinkling pearl chimes, then a sharp crackling sting
EP-G3-1.def: the bell pulses and a ring of water rises: the blade slides through with a soft gloopy swish, bubbles drifting up with an airy chime

EP-G3-2.ko: 작살을 던져 꿰뚫고 물살로 되돌림 · 비늘 꼬리로 감아 막음
EP-G3-2.atk: a coiled tail tenses with a scale rasp, a hurled harpoon punches through with a whooshing throw and a piercing crack, then rushes back along a swirling current into the hand
EP-G3-2.def: scaled coils lock across the blow: a hard grating clank, a hiss, and the tail slithering to brace on the seabed

EP-G3-3.ko: 맹약의 물 일렁여 철썩 · 젖은 가시 되받음
EP-G3-3.atk: an old ritual bowl of water rings once, a heavy dragon-deep wave rises in a long surge, then slams the foe with a booming slap and a sheet of foam
EP-G3-3.def: a bubble-like shield coin shimmers and spins with a bright ring, the blade slides into the water with a soft splash, and sharp coral shards flick back with a pricking spray

PN-G3-C1.ko: 비친 모습이 맞받아침 · 거울 물결이 흔들렸다 다시 고요
PN-G3-C1.atk: a still disc of water chimes softly, its reflection ripples, then flicks a small glassy splash back at the target
PN-G3-C1.def: the blow strikes the mirror surface: a glassy shimmering ripple, a soft watery hum, and the surface smoothing back to stillness without a trace

PN-G3-C3.ko: 깊은 고래 노래가 물을 울려 침 · 거대한 몸으로 받고 물 뿜음
PN-G3-C3.atk: a long deep whale song rolls through the water, rising in pitch, then a pressure wave of sound strikes with a heavy resonant boom
PN-G3-C3.def: the vast barnacled body takes the hit: a deep hollow thud, a burst of blowhole spray, and a slow fluke beat steadying it

PN-G3-U2.ko: 맥박 따라 등불이 깜빡이다 덥석 묾 · 어둠 속 맥박으로 버팀
PN-G3-U2.atk: a deep slow heartbeat thump, a lure buzzing as it brightens, then a gaping fanged maw gulps shut with a wet crunching snap
PN-G3-U2.def: the warty body takes the blow: a dull rubbery thud, the lure flickering, and the heartbeat thumping on steadily in the dark

PN-G3-R.ko: 물그릇 들어 첫 칼 흘림 · 그릇이 버팀
PN-G3-R.atk: a great bowl is tilted with a heavy sloshing glug, a thick ribbon of silvery water pours forward, then lands on the foe with a dulling flat splash that drips off slowly
PN-G3-R.def: water in the bowl bulges up to meet the blade: a blunting wet slap, the edge sliding off with a soft slurp, a blessing shimmer, the bowl standing steady with a deep hum

PN-G3-E.ko: 뱀 비늘 갑옷 찔러 쩍 · 비늘 비껴내고 물로 아묾
PN-G3-E.atk: a heavy scaled gauntlet creaks and serpent coils tense, a lance of serpent-tooth steel slides forward with a long hiss, then punches through with a hard piercing crack and a rasp of scale scraping
PN-G3-E.def: overlapping serpent scales grind and lock: a hard grating clank as the spear skids off, a deep bell-like ring-out, then a soft bubbling wash of healing water

UP-G3-11.ko: 먹물 쏘고 여덟 팔로 휘감음 · 말랑한 몸으로 흘려 받음
UP-G3-11.atk: a deep burbling gurgle, a thick jet of ink hissing through the water, then eight long arms whip and wrap with wet suction pops and a hard squeezing squelch
UP-G3-11.def: the soft body gives way around the blow: a gloopy squish, suckers peeling off with small pops, a cloud of ink blooming with a muffled whoosh

UP-G3-12.ko: 산호 등딱지로 묵직하게 밀쳐 들이받음 · 단단한 산호 껍질
UP-G3-12.atk: slow powerful flippers sweep through water, a heavy coral shell lunges forward with a deep rush, then a crushing shove lands with a gritty hollow crack and coral chips scatter
UP-G3-12.def: the great coral shell takes the blow: a hard hollow clonk, brittle coral crunching, barnacles grinding and a slow calm breath

UP-G3-17.ko: 따뜻한 물결과 함께 둥근 몸으로 툭 · 물렁한 몸이 푹 받음
UP-G3-17.atk: a soft low moan, a broad swell of warm water, then a big plump body nudges forward with a heavy soft bump and a warm splash
UP-G3-17.def: the round body sinks into the blow: a muffled rubbery thump, a slow bubbling breath, warm water swelling and lapping back

UP-G3-18.ko: 세 물기둥 나란히 세움 · 성벽 같은 물
UP-G3-18.atk: three water columns erupt one after another with rising pitch and align with a clean rushing hiss, then fall together in one massive unified crash like a collapsing sea wall
UP-G3-18.def: three columns merge into a smooth towering wall: the hit slams it with a heavy booming thud, the whole wall shudders with a deep wobbling slosh, then stands firm

UP-G3-24.ko: 물 위를 달려 소용돌이로 끌어내림 · 젖은 가죽과 해초 갈기
UP-G3-24.atk: a dark watery whinny, hooves splashing fast across the surface, then a swirling roar of current drags the target down with a deep sucking gurgle
UP-G3-24.def: its wet black hide and kelp mane take the blow: a slick slapping thud, seaweed whipping round, water churning as it rears

MC-03.ko: 물길이 뒤바뀌어 적의 줄이 다시 세워짐
MC-03.cast: a stream suddenly reverses with a deep sucking gurgle, a heavy swirling current drags bodies and shuffles them along the riverbed with wet scraping thuds, then a small warm splash of water returns to the caster

MC-04.cast: knees touch wet sand, water steadily rises and laps with a soft swelling gurgle, a warm glassy shimmer settles over the front line, and tiny ripples fade into calm

MG-03.ko: 샘물 한 모금 꿀꺽 · 몸이 깨어남
MG-03.cast: a cupped hand dips into a spring with a clear plunk, a single refreshing swallow of cool water gulps, then a bright rising shimmer of renewed vitality sparkles up

SG3-01.ko: 환각에 홀린 적 하나를 끌어와 내 편으로 삼음
SG3-01.cast: a wavering glassy shimmer of an illusion, a dreamy watery hum that bends and warps, then a soft pulling swirl as something is drawn across the gap and settles on our side with a calm drop

SG3-02.ko: 물빛 신기루가 두 적의 힘과 몸을 뒤바꿈
SG3-02.cast: a shimmering heat-haze ripple over water, two watery reflections twisting around each other with a rising swirl, and a soft glassy flip as they swap places

SG3-03.ko: 얇은 물 장막이 칼을 무디게 하고 씻어 냄
SG3-03.cast: a thin sheet of water lifts with a fine rushing whisper, a blade slips into it with a soft swish and dulls, then a gentle rinsing wash ripples outward clearing away a faint dark hiss

MG-11.ko: 물거울이 뒤집혀 두 적의 칼과 방패가 뒤바뀜
MG-11.cast: a still pool hums with a glassy tone, its surface flips with a hollow liquid gulp, a sword ring and a shield knock swap places in two quick reversed tones, and a dreamy wavering shimmer lingers

MG-12.cast: blessed water is sprinkled in a bright tinkling rain, a cool wash rinses over the enemy line with a soft hissing swish while a warm bubbling shimmer wraps around the front ally

MG-15.cast: a warm tide rises with a gentle gliding hush, spreads across the whole field in soft lapping ripples, then ebbs away with a trickling drain and a glow of rising sparkles

SG3-09.ko: 큰 해류 방향 틀어 운 떠내려감
SG3-09.cast: a vast slow current groans and swings round, deep water pulls with a hollow sweeping roar, small shiny coins and shells rattle away on the stream, then it fades to a warm lapping tide

RG3-1.ko: 맥박 한 번 크게, 바다가 삼킴
RG3-1.cast: a single colossal bass heartbeat thumps under the sea, the horizon draws back with a huge sucking hiss, then a mountainous wave smashes everything in a deafening crash, leaving a soft calming ripple

NG3-1.cast: the sea roughens with a rising choppy roar, big waves heave one after another with heavy slapping crashes, and foam surges across the land in a long hissing rush

NG3-2.ko: 물살 거꾸로 흘러 뒤 적 밀려나옴
NG3-2.cast: water suddenly reverses with a sucking drag, wet bodies skid over gravel with a rattling shuffle, a hidden foe is shoved forward, then a hard wave smacks it with a thick splash

US-G3-1.cast: a pure ringing tone of water echoes in a deep vessel, a cool translucent wave rolls across the enemy line stripping ornaments with a rinsing hiss and glassy rattle, then a warm calming swell lingers

US-G3-2.cast: water drains away with a long hollow slurp, a deep distant throb, then the sea rushes back in a heaving swell that sweeps the enemy with a crash and gently washes the allies in warm lapping ripples

PS-G3-1.cast: a still pond surface hums with a glassy tone, a flash of reflection flips with a quick liquid twist, and a pair of sounds, one sharp and one heavy, swap places with a soft splash

PS-G3-2.cast: water drains away with a long draining gurgle, shingle rattles back down the beach, a heavy wave energy deflates with a sighing hiss, and everything goes slack and quiet

RS-G3-1.ko: 작살이 물살 타고 방패도 씻고 박힘
RS-G3-1.cast: a harpoon whistles along a rushing stream, rinsing away a shield with a washing hiss, then bites into the foe with a deep sharp thunk and a draining trickle

RS-G3-2.cast: a mass of soap-like sea foam bubbles up and wraps the front ally with a fizzy crackle, a blade skids on it with a squeak, tiny droplets patter, and warm bubbles close wounds with soft pops

RS-G3-3.ko: 차오르는 밀물이 적 운 쓸고 아군 적심
RS-G3-3.cast: a rising tide gurgles in, a deep hollow conch tone rings and holds, a wave sweeps the enemy with a rushing wash, and warm water laps gently around the allied feet

CS-G3.ko: 주문을 씻어내고 적 전체의 보호를 벗김
CS-G3.cast: a half-formed spell crackles, a clean cold wave douses it with a hissing snuff, then a wide washing rush sweeps across the whole enemy line, stripping wards with a glassy chiming rattle

IG3-1.equip: a polished seashell on a cord is looped over a neck with a soft slither, clicks against another shell with a dry clack, and gives a faint ocean-like hush when held

IG3-2.equip: a stoppered flask is uncorked with a soft pop, clear water glugs and trickles into a hand, and the cork taps back in with a light knock and a warm shimmer

IG3-3.equip: a red coral dagger slides into a belt sheath with a dry gritty scrape, a brittle tick of coral, and one quick test flick that whistles with a curving swish like a throw

IG3-4.equip: a pearl-studded emblem is pinned to a chest with a small metal click, the pearls roll with a soft glassy rattle, and one finger tap rings with a clear tiny tone

IG3-5.equip: a glass orb holding one drop is lifted with a delicate glass tick, the drop inside swirls with a tiny sloshing wobble, and a thin watery whine hums when it is squeezed

IG3-6.equip: a single iridescent scale is pressed onto armour with a wet sticky squeak, then a thin glassy chime shimmers as it settles, and a blade tapped on it skids with a slick slither

IG3-7.equip: a heavy silver chalice is set down with a solid clink, water fills it with a bubbling gurgle, then brims over and runs down its sides in a warm trickling stream
